title: macOS Golden Gate adds a new app to your Mac; here’s what it can do
summary: This marks the first time that Apple has released a dedicated Siri app for the Mac. While I think the app is relatively basic, I’m pleased that Apple decided to release a chatbot-style Siri app with macOS 27.
